book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Mabholu gha akahokolu
Bhela bhakumu wa bhabhola bha Shelia na Mafalisayo kuhuma ku Yelusalemu bhakahikiki kwaka Yesu, na kundalukila,
“Bho, mbona bhabhulwa bhaku ngachebhajengalela mabholu ghatujopalile kuhuma kwa akahokolu bhitu? Maghambu bhombi ngachebhachamba machi mawoku ghabhu ngati mokupalakila mangane ja kula!”
Yesu akabhayangiki, “Bho, mbona mwehapa ngachemkamu amuli yaka Chapanga kwa ndandi ja mitetu jinu mabhene?
Kwa ndandi Chapanga akapwaghiki, ‘Watopila atati waku na mabhu waku’ na ‘Jokapi joandobhe masolu atati waki au mabhu waki, impalika akomakikaje.’
Nambu mwehapa mpwagha kubha mundu anaabhi na chindu cheaweza kubhajangati atati waki au mabhu waki, ‘Nambu akampwaghila kubha chindu achechi nimboki Chapanga,’
bhela ngacheapalika kabheti kunjangati atati waki. Anana nde monyakila Lilobhi laka Chapanga na kujengalela mitetu jinu.
Mwehapa mabhandu mwemulibhona kubha wambone! Mlota Isaya akapwaghiki wichu panani jinu paakalotiki malobhi hagha,

content: Mambu ghaghuntenda mundu ngaijetakalewa na Chapanga
Yesu akalilohiki lipogha la bhandu lela, na kubhapwaghila, “Njowanyaje wichu, na mmanyaje.
Chindu chechuntenda mundu kubha muhakau nga chela chechunjingi mundomu waki, nambu nde chela chechumpita mundu mundomu waki.”
Panihapa bhabhulwa bhaki bhakahikiki, na kumpwaghila, “Bho, umanyi kubha Mafalisayo bhakahakali namaa kwa malobhi ghala ghaukapwaghike?”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Kila nkongu wangakupandakika na Atati wangu wa kunani kumahunde, anautupulikaje.
Mwalekaje, bhanihabha nde akangalola, bhabhalongoha akangalola bhajabhu. Na ngati ngalola andongoha ngalola njaki, bhokapi bhabheli anabhajibhala mulibhomba.”
Petulu akapwaghiki, “Utupwaghilaye ndandi ja ulenganesu ghone.”
Yesu akabhalalukile, “Bho, hata na mwehapa le mwakona ngachemumanyi ghangane?
Bho, ngachemmanyi kubha kila chechunjingi mundu mundomu waki, chipetela mulutumbu, na kupihakika kunja kulikelo?
Nambu chechipita mundomu waka mundu chipita kuhuma muntima, na chenihechi nde chechuntenda mundu kubha muhakau.
Kwa ndandi mkati ja mtima waka mundu ghapita maholalelu mahakau, maholalelu gha kukoma, ugone na ukemi, wihi na ulandilu wa upuhi, na matondu.
Ghanihagha nde ghaghuntenda mundu ngaijetakalewa palongi jaka Chapanga, nambu kula panga kuchamba machi mabhoku ngachekuntenda mundu kubha muhakau.”
Uhobhalelu waka mbomba jumu
Yesu akabhokiki pandu pala na kujenda ku inchi ja ku Tilo na ku Sidoni.
Mbomba jumu Mkanaani joatamika pandu panihapa akahikiki kwaka Yesu, na kujamalila, “Bambo! Mwana waka Daude, umonila chiha, kamwali wangu ang'ahakika na lijobhi.”
Nambu Yesu ngacheakamuyangiki lilobhi lokapi. Bhela bhabhulwa bhaki bhakanjendili na kundobha, bhakapwaghaje, “Umpwaghila ajendaje, maghambu atujengalela, na ajendalela kutulapuli ngomela.”
Yesu akayangiki, “Ndumakiki pena kwa bhandu bha ku Izilaeli bhabhabhi ngati mambeleli ghaghahobhike.”
Nambu mbomba jola akahikiki, akachikimi polongi jaka Yesu, na kupwagha, “Bambo, unyangatyaje!”
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Nga wichu kutola chilebhi cha bhana na kulekalela nakawa.”
Mbomba jola akayangiki, “Ena, Bambo, upwaghiki chakaka, nambu hata nakawa ikula mahighalilu ghaghahabhuka kuhuma pameza ya akabambo wabhu.”
Panihapa Yesu akayangiki, “Mabhu, uhobhalelu waku nde kukolongwa! Kubya kwaku ngati moulobhile.” Kutumbu chikahi chelachela mwali waki akalamike.
Yesu abhalamiha bhhandu bhamahele
Yesu akabhokiki pandu pala akapetiki mumaheku ja nhwanga Galilaya. Akakweliki pa chitombi na kutama pahi.

Lipogha likolongwa la bhandu lakunjendile, bhakumpelakili ilema, na akangalola, na iwete, na akangajowa, na bhangi bhamahele bhabhakabhi bhatamwa, bhakabhabhekiki pambipi na magholu ghaki, najombi Yesu akabhalamihe.

Lipogha la bhandu lela bhakakangichi pabhakaweni akangapwagha, bhakapwaghaje, na ilema bhakalamaje, na bhabhatengwiki bhakajendaje, na iwete bhakalamaje, na akangalola bhakalolaje, na bhakundumbali Chapanga wa Izilaeli.
Yesu abhapekeha chilebhi bhandu bhangi elufu ncheche

Yesu akabhalohiki bhabhulwa bhaki na kubhapwaghila, “Nabhonela chiha bhandu abhabha, maghambu bhabhi na nepane kwa machobha ghatatu, na sajenu ngachebhabhi na chilebhi. Ngachembala nabhatabhuka koni bhakabya na injala ngabhihika kung'anduka mwindela.”
Bhabhulwa bhaki bhakumpwaghile, “Pambane tubhi pachingwenji, bho, anatupata kwaku chilebhi cha kubhajaghanila bhandu bhokapi abhabha?”
Yesu akabhalalukile, “Bho, mbi na mabumunda ghalenga?” Na bhombi bhakamuyangiki, “Tubhi na mabumunda saba, na tuhomba tuchokope.”
Yesu akabhapwaghi bhandu bhatama pahi.
Panihapa akatoliki mabumunda saba ghala na homba yela, akanchengwi Chapanga, na akahekiki, na kubhapekeha bhabhulwa bhaki, na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakabhapeki bhandu.
Bhokapi bhakakuliki na kutupila. Panihapa bhabhulwa bhakabhongini hipandi yeyakahighalile, bhakatwelakela hitonga saba.
Bhandu bhabhakakuliki chilebhi chela bhakabhi akanalomi elufu ncheche, panga kubhabhalanga akambomba na bhana.
Paakajomwi kubhatabhuka bhandu, Yesu akajingi mu ngalawa, na kujenda upambala wa ku Magadani.
